rows.text: ماشي الامور تمام وبوصل بعد ١٥ دقيقة
at the address, nobody is answering the door
واقف عند الباب ولا احد يفتح
stuck, there is an accident on the road
I don't have this parcel on the van
blocked for at least an hour
